topic: How should the sk-create-chart mode chart templates and delivered output improve, measured against what the best open-source charting libraries produce?

focus: Upstream baseline survey: Chart.js, Vega-Lite, ECharts, Plotly
noveltyJustification: First pass over this packet; upstream facts are new to the lineage

ruledOut.approach: Survey all six libraries in iteration 1
ruledOut.reason: Exceeded per-iteration tool budget; split D3/Plot to iteration 2

focus: D3 and Observable Plot baselines: ticks, nice, d3-format, mark doctrine
noveltyJustification: D3/Plot API facts are new to this lineage; corpus comparisons build on iteration 1

ruledOut.approach: Adopting D3 tick machinery as dependency
Two-sided d3-style nicing across corpus forms
ruledOut.reason: Would break the zero-baseline discipline the corpus playbook tests

focus: Label and legend placement conventions vs corpus swatch row
noveltyJustification: Placement mechanisms (layout-reserved vs in-figure) and width-estimate fragility newly tied to corpus lines

ruledOut.reason: Contract forbids libraries; upstream avoids overlap by layout, not by solving overlap
Corpus already partially applies anchor flips; only shared measurement is missing

focus: Colour ramp conventions vs corpus gated 5-step ramp
noveltyJustification: Ramp-shape/safety/legend split resolved separately; corpus gate superiority and missing CVD documentation are new

ruledOut.approach: Adding a diverging colour system now
ruledOut.reason: No catalog form consumes a midpoint ramp; would repeat the fourth-system mistake (color-system.md:127)

focus: Accessibility: screen-reader, contrast, non-colour encoding vs rule-10 trio
noveltyJustification: Library a11y mechanics and WCAG gate mapping are new; desc-staleness and decal candidates are new gaps

ruledOut.reason: Bloat of scenegraph/output SVG — Vega's own release-notes concern validates corpus granularity
Changes the shared visual register; per-form decision instead

focus: Responsive sizing conventions vs corpus viewBox scaling
noveltyJustification: Plot/Vega-Lite sizing mechanics and min-size guard/gutter-budget gaps are new; Chart.js restated for the record

ruledOut.reason: All upstream re-layouts require a runtime; contract forbids

focus: Data-mark relationship: transforms, data shapes, missing data
noveltyJustification: Transform/stack mechanics and the shape-enforcement gap are new; computed-value discipline consolidated with fresh citations

ruledOut.reason: Would weaken per-form expressive shapes; contract keeps literal typed arrays
Contract forbids computing in the data path (template-contract.md:87)

focus: Number and date formatting conventions vs corpus String(value)
noveltyJustification: Concrete fmt helper design and float-dust/display-ready-label findings are new

ruledOut.reason: A delivered file must not change shape across locales
Rotation needs runtime layout; truncation fights direct labelling

focus: Interaction and tooltips: dependency-free affordances and determinism boundary
noveltyJustification: Native SVG title mechanics and per-form mapping are new; verified against all 13 corpus checks

ruledOut.approach: JS floating tooltip as corpus-wide default
ruledOut.reason: Adds runtime surface, no screenshot value, native title + table already cover it

focus: Reconciliation and ranking: template-level vs contract-level recommendation list
noveltyJustification: Ranking tables, reconciliation column and coverage check reorganize nine iterations into decision-ready form
